Subject: Intro call recap: security intake & next steps

Hi Kyle / Aisha —

Thanks again for taking the intro call today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we have clear handoffs: 

Summary from our call
- Aurora Health is evaluating Redwood for clinical-document summarization and patient communication workflows.
- Primary concerns: SOC 2 Type II evidence, HIPAA handling, data residency and retention, and procurement timeline.

Immediate asks / proposed owners
1) SOC 2 evidence & bridge letter — Kyle, can you confirm the latest SOC 2 Type II report period and whether you can share the report or a bridge letter? (procurement/legal often prefer a bridge letter when the most-recent report is outside the expected period).
2) Trust portal access — we will need a read-only Trust/Docs portal account (or SSO invite) for Aurora to receive our required intake docs and for you to upload the filled VSQ. We can send the portal link once NDA is in place.
3) Vendor security questionnaire (VSQ) — Ill share our standard VSQ (spreadsheet). Procurement (Aisha) to confirm who will own completion.
4) NDA for portal upload — to expedite, attaching a draft mutual NDA and a sample bridge letter from our side (attached). Please confirm if Aurora has a standard procurement NDA and whether you prefer DocuSign.

Attachments: Redwood-Bridge-Letter-sample.pdf (sample), Draft_NDA-Aurora.pdf (draft mutual NDA)

Proposed timeline
- NDA executed and portal invite: 2–3 business days after signature
- VSQ completion: procurement-led; target 5 business days
- SOC 2 report/bridge letter: as available — ideally attached to the portal or emailed to security@redwood.ai

Next steps for us
- I will follow up with a DocuSign link for the NDA and post the VSQ template. Marissa will draft a short HIPAA controls summary (one-pager) to share.

Thanks — feel free to loop in anyone else from procurement/security.

Best,
Jonas

Thanks for the summary — that matches our notes. Quick answers: 
- SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type II report for the period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31. I can either upload the full report to the portal or provide a signed bridge letter if you need a short attestation while procurement finishes paperwork.
- NDA: Procurement prefers DocuSign for auditability. Aisha will take the NDA and route to legal if needed.
- VSQ: Aisha will shepherd the VSQ internally; shes the main contact.
- HIPAA: We are HIPAA-covered and have BAAs in place for PHI processors; I know youre asking for a controls summary — thats doable.

I dont have SSO SP metadata off-hand; if you can issue a portal invite to security@aurorahealth.com and procurement@aurorahealth.com well accept and confirm upload locations.

Ill aim to get either the SOC 2 report or a bridge letter into the portal early next week after NDA is signed.
